questions.question_english: The financial power to grant medical advances to serving employees usually vests with:
options_english: The respective Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) or Head of Department
The Medical Superintendent of the treating government or empanelled hospital
The authorized local chemist empanelled with the regional wellness centre
The Chief Minister of the state acting through the executive relief portal
questions.explanation_english: The respective Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) or Head of Department. Upon verifying hospital estimates and eligibility parameters, the administrative officer sanctions the advance from contingent funds, disbursing funds directly to the hospital or employee.

These rules outline entitlements for medical care, consultation procedures, emergency treatments, and financial claims for employees stationed outside the geographical jurisdiction covered by wellness centres.
